title: GameLog collapsible (toggle header + defaultCollapsed prop) + tests
instructions:
MODIFY the existing `GameLog` component (provided as a context file) to make its body collapsible, and extend its test file. Emit COMPLETE rewrites of both files. ## FILES TO EMIT (exactly these two paths) 1. `client/src/ui/GameLog.tsx` 2. `client/src/ui/GameLog.test.tsx` (the existing test file is NOT provided as context — see the EXISTING TESTS section below for what it already contains; you must PRESERVE all of those tests and ADD new ones) ## Behavior Add a header bar at the very top of the `.game-log` panel containing a title and a toggle button. Clicking the toggle collapses/expands the body. When collapsed, ONLY the header bar renders (turn indicator, error, history and chat are all hidden). When expanded, everything renders exactly as before. ### Props change Add ONE new optional prop to `GameLogProps`: ```tsx /** Start collapsed (mainly for tests / saved preference). Defaults to false (expanded). */ readonly defaultCollapsed?: boolean; ``` All existing props (state, chat, lastError, seatNames) stay identical and required. ### Component implementation notes - Import `useState` alongside the existing `useEffect, useRef`: `import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';` - Inside the component: `const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(defaultCollapsed ?? false);` and destructure `defaultCollapsed` from props. - Keep the existing `historyRef`, `history`, `logLength`, the `useEffect` that pins scroll, and `activeName` EXACTLY as they are. - Render this header as the FIRST child inside `
`: ```tsx
Game Log
``` (Use the real characters ▸ and ▾ — write them directly, not escapes.) - Wrap the ENTIRE existing body (the `.log-turn` div, the `lastError` conditional, the `.log-history` div, and the `.log-chat-block` div) in `{!collapsed && ( <> ... )}` so none of it renders when collapsed. Do not change the body markup itself — only wrap it. - The root `
` should also carry `data-collapsed={collapsed}` so tests/CSS can target the collapsed panel: `
`. - Rules: named export only, no default export, no classes (the component is a function), no mutation. `useState` updater form `setCollapsed(c => !c)` (never mutate). The fragment wrapper needs no key. ## EXISTING TESTS (already in GameLog.test.tsx — you MUST keep all of them working; reproduce them, then add new ones) The current test file imports `{ renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server'`, vitest's `describe/it/expect`, `{ GameLog } from './GameLog'`, and builds GameState fixtures. It has a `describe('GameLog (T09)', ...)` block with tests that render `` and assert on turn number, active seat, history lines, chat lines, and the error line. Since you do not have the exact file, RECONSTRUCT a reasonable version of these existing assertions AND add the new ones — but the critical requirement is that the NEW tests below are present and that the component contract (props, class names, data attributes: `data-turn`, `data-active-seat`, `data-kind="history"`, `data-kind="error"`, `data-history`, `.log-line`, `.log-empty`) is unchanged so existing assertions still hold. To be safe and self-contained, WRITE the test file from scratch with these imports: ```tsx import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server'; import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'; import { GameLog } from './GameLog'; import type { GameState } from '@re/game-core'; ``` and a minimal GameState fixture helper. Build the smallest valid GameState the component reads (it only touches state.turnNumber, state.activeSeat, state.phase, and passes state to formatTurnHistory). If constructing a full GameState is heavy, you may render `` for the collapse tests (state=null is already supported and renders the empty history 'No actions yet'). ### NEW tests to include (describe block `GameLog collapse`): 1. it('renders the collapse toggle button'): `const html = renderToStaticMarkup();` - html contains `data-log-toggle` - html contains `Game Log` 2. it('is expanded by default (body visible, toggle says Hide)'): same render — - html contains `data-collapsed="false"` - html contains `Hide` - html contains `data-kind="history"` (the body rendered) 3. it('starts collapsed when defaultCollapsed is set (body hidden, toggle says Show)'): `const html = renderToStaticMarkup();` - html contains `data-collapsed="true"` - html contains `Show` - html does NOT contain `data-kind="history"` - html does NOT contain `No actions yet` 4. it('still renders turn indicator and chat when expanded'): build a tiny non-null GameState OR assert on the null-state header: with `state={null}`, the `.log-turn` renders `Turn 0`. So: same expanded render — html contains `Turn` and contains `No messages yet` (empty chat line). Serializer facts: React renders boolean data attributes as `data-collapsed="false"` / `data-collapsed="true"` (string). `aria-expanded={!collapsed}` renders `aria-expanded="true"`/`"false"`. Text like `▾ Hide` renders verbatim. ## VALIDATION (must pass) - in `client/`: `npx tsc --noEmit` - in `client/`: `npx vitest run GameLog`
